quotes.text: A story is not a line to be followed, but a garden to be wandered through; the most beautiful blooms are often found off the beaten path.
quotes.author: Eleanor Vance

quotes.text: Writing is the alchemy of turning the leaden silence of thought into the gold of shared understanding.
quotes.author: Professor Alistair Finch

quotes.text: Do not build your characters from clay, ready for the kiln. Carve them from living wood, that they may grow in directions even you cannot foresee.
quotes.author: M. Thorne

quotes.text: The blank page is not a void to be feared, but the universe before the first star—awaiting the gravity of your first word to begin the collapse into a new world.
quotes.author: Dr. Isolde Gray
